import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.next();
        int n = s.length();
        int flag_at = 0;
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (i == 0 && s.startsWith("at", i)) {
                result.append("at");
                i += 1;
            } else if (i == 0 && s.startsWith("dot", i)) {
                result.append("dot");
                i += 3 - 1; // since loop will increment i, subtract 1
            } else if (i == n - 2 && s.startsWith("at", i)) {
                result.append("at");
                break;
            } else if (i == n - 3 && s.startsWith("dot", i)) {
                result.append("dot");
                break;
            } else if (s.startsWith("at", i) && flag_at == 0) {
                result.append("@");
                flag_at = 1;
                i += 1;
            } else if (s.startsWith("dot", i)) {
                result.append(".");
                i += 3 - 1; // since loop will increment i, subtract 1
            } else {
                result.append(s.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        System.out.println(result.toString());
        sc.close();
    }
}
